l. 6 and 13 ποληων -> <:πορείων|reg|ποληων:> Consider the interchanges of λ and ρ, and the ει and η; for the latter cf. P.Tebt. I 195v λόγος πορήων and Πετεῆσιν πορή(ων); P.Coll.Youtie I 17, 6 δύο πορήων. In ed. princ. G and H (5n.) proposed that this word is a phonological mistake instead of πώλων or πλοίων. Johnson, Roman Egypt, 1936, no 102, pp. 174-176, translates “loads(?)”. Actually this is the “beast of burden, pack animal”, as translated by A.E. Hanson in P.Coll.Youtie I 17.
